info.name: Get solar times for a location and date

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

params.name: lng
params.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

params.name: date
params.description: Date for which to retrieve solar times. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD format or relative values such as "today". Defaults to the current date.

params.name: callback
params.description: JSONP callback function name. When provided, the response is wrapped in the specified function call.

params.name: formatted
params.description: When set to 0, times are returned as ISO 8601 strings (UTC). When set to 1 (default), times are formatted as 12-hour clock strings.

params.name: tzid
params.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., UTC, America/New_York, Europe/London). When provided, all times in the response are returned in the specified timezone.

items.docs: Returns sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, civil twilight, nautical twilight, and astronomical twilight times for the specified latitude/longitude coordinate and date. Responses are in JSON or JSONP. Times are in UTC by default unless a timezone identifier is provided.
